title: The Story of VS Code | Official Documentary
original_title: The Story of VS Code | Official Documentary
overview: Erich Gamma once said that VS Code was an overnight success that took 10 years in the making. Those 10 years were quite intense.  Before becoming one of the most widely used development tools in the world, VS Code started with a small team creating online developer tools out of Zurich. It was called Monaco, then Visual Studio Online Monaco, then Ticino (why not?), became a desktop editor, went open source, grew into an ecosystem of its own, returned to the browser, and helped establish a whole bunch of open protocols along the way.  And just when it seemed like the hardest part was over, AI arrived.  This is the story of how VS Code got here, told by the people who built it and the developers who helped shape it. And now, how it's adapting once again as AI transforms the very concept of a code editor.

Born for the Ring is a story about family, sacrifice, perseverance, and the true meaning of victory.

title: Fork in the Road

Through a tapestry of compelling stories from independent small-scale farmers across the United States, from Alaskan kelp harvesters to dairy farmers in Kentucky, the film reveals the authentic, lived realities and unprecedented challenges of those working against the tide of escalating industrialization in agriculture. Featuring insights from visionary chefs and culinary experts, Fork in the Road expands the conversation beyond the farm, demonstrating how food sustainability is a shared responsibility that extends into our kitchens and communities. More than a call to environmental action, the film illuminates the vital ways that sustainable food practices can nourish our bodies, strengthen our communities, and heal the Earth.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades

The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Black Knights

Filmed remotely during the COVID-19 pandemic and the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan, the film blends intimate remote interviews, archival military footage, presidential speeches, and personal photos. It chronicles their time at the United States Military Academy, deployments to Iraq, Afghanistan, Kuwait, and South Korea, and transitions into successful civilian careers and graduate school. Notably, the documentary highlights the group's diversity by embracing its LGBTQ+ members. By celebrating profound male bonds, Black Knights challenges traditional narratives and preconceived notions about who serves in the U.S. military and what military service means for America.

Jodi is a wild romp about the pleasures of rock n roll, sapphic love, and torture…don’t miss it!!

title: People on Trial

As the trial continues to drag on, the film captures the silent suffering endured by a man and his family, particularly his mother, and the unbearable burden of waiting.

title: Newlyweds
overview: After murdering his bride on the night of their wedding, a panicked groom races down a road to dispose of her body before dawn. But as the miles disappear beneath his tires, unsettling phone calls, impossible visions, and a growing presence in the backseat begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare. Trapped alone with his guilt, he soon discovers that some truths refuse to stay buried.

title: Taboo Cocoon
overview: The life of a hypochondriacal Internet musician takes a turn for the worse after an unexpected reunion with a childhood best friend runs parallel to a wave of mass killings.

title: The Quiet Fight
overview: Sometimes the hardest fights are fought from within.

title: A Kindness
overview: After fleeing a blood-soaked nightmare in the woods, a priest seeks shelter in the home of a kind suburban woman.

title: Left ın the Dark
overview: On a dark night, Uncle Sabi, an elderly motorcyclist, offers a ride to a young woman he encounters by chance. title: Lewis Capaldi: Live at American Express Presents BST Hyde Park
original_title: Lewis Capaldi: Live at American Express Presents BST Hyde Park

title: Long Live Bernie

title: No Sun on Salvation

title: Artichoke
overview: Held captive in a violent relationship, Cynara discovers a phoropter that opens a portal to another world. In a terrifying cat-and-mouse chase between realities, Cynara finally comes face to face with her oppressor and must decide what she’s willing to destroy in order to survive.

title: You Dreamt You Saw Yourself But Couldn’t See Your Face
original_title: You Dreamt You Saw Yourself But Couldn’t See Your Face
overview: A quiet whistling returned from childhood; the calm of a sky and a river dissolving into one another, from which emerges the image of a loved one. For the duration of a reflection, the water reveals memories and offers the delicacy of a glimpse into the course of a life.

title: Pure Reason
overview: Starting from a fragment of wall and a daily ritual, an experiment in the perception of colour. How do light and time construct it?

title: I Couldn’t Draw You A Map
original_title: I Couldn’t Draw You A Map

title: Cat's Blood (Proof of Concept)

title: Get to Work
overview: A man struggles in his bathroom through a severe panic attack as he desperately tries to work through it and get to work on time.

title: Hag
overview: When an escort finds herself losing work to younger women, she tumbles down a path of self-destruction, her actions fueled by an ever-increasing obsession to look younger.

title: Walking to You
overview: A couple on the edge of a breakup discover a supernatural force that's keeping them together

title: Fire Tornado
overview: A dysfunctional rehab group is stranded at a rundown cabin as a roaring firenado melts everything in its path. With roads gone and heat rising, the misfits must combine their strange skills to fortify the house and survive the firestorm’s return.

title: Popeye 4 : Resurrection
overview: A fanatical cult resurrects Popeye, convinced they can bend his legendary strength to their will. Instead, he rises furious and uncontrollable, cutting a violent path through anyone who summoned him. As chaos spreads and the cult’s plan collapses, one determined survivor must confront the unstoppable sailor and end his rampage once and for all in this explosive finale.

title: Chhota Bheem And Hatim - The Legend of First Jinn
original_title: Chhota Bheem And Hatim - The Legend of First Jinn
overview: Chhota Bheem and Hatim: The Legend of the First Jinn is an animated fantasy-adventure television movie produced by Green Gold Animation that premiered on POGO TV on July 5, 2026. The story follows Dholakpur’s brave hero, Chhota Bheem, who forms an unexpected alliance with the legendary warrior Hatim after the evil entity Zuzu abducts Princess Indumati and traps her inside a magic lamp. Together, the duo must cross treacherous Arabian deserts and navigate a dangerous, magical world filled with complex puzzles and mystical trials. As they fight to defeat Zuzu and rescue the princess, Bheem and Hatim must learn to trust one another, discovering that true power lies in unity, compassion, and shared values rather than raw strength.

title: Robert Richardson: The White Devil
overview: What started as a student exercise and master’s degree project soon evolved into a creative partnership and personal friendship between Jana Hojdová, a former cinematography student at Prague’s FAMU, and distinguished cinematographer Robert Richardson.

title: Popeye III: Requiem
overview: When a covert research team imprisons Popeye to harness his superhuman strength as a military weapon, their experiment spirals violently out of control. Transformed into an unstoppable force driven by rage, Popeye tears through the facility, leaving destruction in his wake. With time running out and casualties mounting, one scientist risks everything to stop the monster they created - before he reaches the outside world.

title: WOLF

title: CarousHELL 4

On a father/son vacation to a cabin in the woods, Robbie finds the Nekkomeownicon and tries to speak to his late mother. But these words are instead heard by The Leviathan and its demon horde.

title: Forsyth Frontier: A Foundation and Future
original_title: Forsyth Frontier: A Foundation and Future
overview: A look into the past, present, and future of Forsyth County as we reflect on the 250th year milestone of America.

title: Those Kids

title: Holo

title: Lou's Team: The Story of the Humboldt Crabs
original_title: Lou's Team: The Story of the Humboldt Crabs
overview: Nestled in the redwood forest of Northern California, the Humboldt Crabs, founded in 1945, are the oldest continuously operated summer collegiate baseball team, with their own band, ardent fans, and tradition of winning.

title: Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders
overview: “Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders" peels back the layers of controversy surrounding the making of the 1980 thriller, "Cruising." Directed by William Friedkin, the film triggered fierce protests from the LGBTQ+ community for its portrayal of a serial killer targeting gay men in New York's leather bars. Friedkin drew inspiration from the brutal murder of Variety reporter Addison Verrill, blurring the boundaries between cinematic fiction and real-life tragedy.

title: Cotton Fever
overview: A mosaic of characters struggle with addiction and love on the streets of Boston during the height of the fentanyl epidemic

title: Outtake
overview: An LA talent agent’s career is put in jeopardy when his client gets blacklisted from Hollywood.

title: 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero
overview: After the 9/11 attacks, after the smoke was gone, after the rubble cleared away, New Yorkers had a city to rebuild. In response to fast-tracked redevelopment plans, more than 5,000 people gathered in the largest town hall in American history. They came to vote on the city’s six proposals for rebuilding Ground Zero. But instead, the people rejected the top down approach and successfully charted a new path forward. Their work determined what is at Ground Zero today. And their story is an example of what democracy can look like.

title: Rare Birds

title: The Campaign

It’s a war fought through propaganda, disinformation, and emotional manipulation, amplified by both mainstream and social media.

title: Mantle of Dusk
overview: From the mouth of the mad river.

Wet Paper Bag is a psychological drama that explores identity, control, and the quiet tension beneath carefully constructed lives.

In his efforts to sell the precious item to a wealthy collector, the scheme begins to deteriorate into paranoia, dangerous situations, and unhealthy relationships. When faced with the results of his dishonesty, he must confront himself and understand the true consequences of his actions.

overview: Comprised of all still photographs, a film exploring a persons isolation and mental deterioration.

original_title: The World Is Our Dance Floor

title: Hope
overview: On the last day of college, three lives quietly collide with memories, choices, and unspoken feelings. Hope is a poetic reflection on timing, love, and the moments that could have changed everything.  Hope follows three hearts bound by silence, longing, and what remains unsaid. A gentle story about love, timing, and the fragile beauty of unanswered emotions.

title: The Lost Ones
overview: Motivated by his sister's disappearance, a man sneaks into the seemingly perfect town of Gloomshade Grove, only to reveal its chilling secret that holds the community together.

title: Dinamita
overview: After a harsh breakup, a soul-crushing job, and the pain of watching her ex move on with someone new, Cristina reaches a breaking point. What starts as a fleeting intrusive thought turns into a wild, reckless plan to erase him from her life — a choice that will send her down a path with no way back.

title: Greektown Wrestling 5.29.16

Packed with deathmatch icons, international stars, and a highly anticipated war inside the steel structure, this event promises a classic, chaotic night of elite independent wrestling.

title: Mystery Wrestling #25.5
overview: Mystery Wrestling #25.5 aired May 29, 2026

title: Hard To Notice
overview: As Itay prepares for his mandatory military service, his sister’s intimate lens captures a family on the edge. What starts as a bittersweet portrait of parental anxiety takes a dramatic turn when frustration leads Itay to a suicide attempt in his military base. Through raw, uncensored conversations, and with the healing power of the camera, the family is forced to confront years of denial, finally discovering the truth: Itay is autistic. A moving journey from alienation to acceptance, showing how one diagnosis can transform a “broken” young man into a person finally seen for who he truly is.

As their conversation unfolds in fragments and jump cuts, the film explores how easily two people can feel close through conversation alone, and how fragile that closeness can be once the call ends

title: The Giving Thief
overview: What begins as a Christmas gathering slowly unravels into something deeply unsettling. Beneath the warmth of shared memories and holiday traditions lingers the quiet absence of Michael, a friend whose name carries an uncomfortable weight. Strange, deeply personal gifts surface throughout the night, objects that feel less like gestures of friendship and more like intended reminders, turning the celebration into something tense and uneasy. As suspicion and discomfort quietly take hold, sirens cut through the night and Tim vanishes without explanation, leaving the group and the evening itself changed.
